patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width white, dark blue, and dark green backgrounds to clearly delineate content blocks and create visual rhythm.
A strong, bold sans-serif is used for all major headings, creating immediate impact and clear hierarchy, while a more neutral sans-serif provides readability for body text.
A vibrant, energetic green (#00bf6f) is consistently used as a primary accent and call-to-action color, contrasting effectively with the deep professional blue (#05467e) and clean white backgrounds.
Content sections and key elements reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Each major content section features a prominent, concise headline, often accompanied by a visual element or data points, to quickly convey its purpose and value.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, maintaining its original appearance without transformation.

Content sections and individual elements within them are animated to subtly fade in and slide up from the bottom as they scroll into the user's view, creating a dynamic and engaging reveal effect, likely leveraging CSS keyframes.
Interactive elements like buttons, input fields, and content cards consistently feature a moderate, uniform corner radius, contributing to a friendly yet professional aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~3-4x body text) establish clear hierarchy, complemented by legible body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels for detail.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded, consistently applied to buttons, cards, and interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and generous, with ample vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, contributing to a clean and professional layout.

standout: The confident and consistent application of a vibrant, energetic green as the primary accent color against a deep, professional blue and clean white. This color choice is not just for CTAs but also for key data points and visual highlights, making the site feel dynamic and trustworthy simultaneously.
